mapper.select: SELECT * FROM {{schema}}.ShopOrderLines AS ol WHERE ol.Quantity > 1 AND ol.ProductId IN (SELECT l2.ToProductId FROM {{schema}}.ShopProductLinks AS l2 WHERE l2.FromProductId = 3 OR l2.FromProductId IN (SELECT l1.ToProductId FROM {{schema}}.ShopProductLinks AS l1 WHERE l1.FromProductId = 3))
